Name: Vegas' Item Compatibility Patch
Author: VegasOctober
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]
After the recent [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] 1.15 update introduced some new items, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url] quickly released a couple of compatibility updates that allowed mods with conflicting item names to be used together. In most cases, this compatibility update removed duplicate items, which may cause some issues with bundles or other mods or recipes that require certain items. I thought back to this same issue w/ Cornucopia - More Flowers, and how it renamed the Rafflesia flowers added by both mods to be distinct and let them both exist together as different breeds of the same flower. So, I thought I'd do the same with the conflicting items between SVE, Cornucopia's suite of mods, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url] too, allowing all items with overlapping names to be used together.

With that, this compatibility patch was born. All items across all mods remain in the game and available to grow, sell, add to bundles, cook with, gift, etc. The only difference is the display name of conflicting items have been updated to remove the conflict between similarly-named items. These renames will apply to the fruits/vegetables/artisan goods themselves, their seeds/saplings, and any recipes that use these ingredients, to clearly indicate what's going on, and delineate between the 2 conflicting items. I've also added machine rule compatibility, where applicable, to allow these mods to play together better. For example: SVE Cucumbers can be used in a Preserves Jar to make Cornucopia Pickle Spears.

Additionally, in all cases, I attempted to come up with fun, interesting, realistic or lore-friendly ways to rename items, be it match up actual breeds of fruits/vegetables with real-world counterparts that match their image, description, and harvest season, or refer to in-game lore and existing descriptions. I admittedly didn't spend too much time trying to perfectly align these things, but hey, it should be fun regardless!

All mods supported by this mod are optional, but will always rename items with potential conflicts. That means you can use this mode to remove all conflicts between any set of supported mods you have, and you can opt out of any other supported mods you don't want (for example, you can use this w/ SVE and Cornucopia, but you don't need Wildflour or Bonster's). That also means, however, if you end up using a subset of mods that doesn't actually produce a conflict (again in this example, Sapodilla comes w/ Cornucopia and Bonster's, but since you don't have Bonster's, you won't have a conflict) it will rename the items anyway. This is to both simplify the implementation of the renaming, as well as to always allow any number and combination of conflicting mods to be used together for maximum flexibility and ease of use. Basically, if you have a supported mod installed, it'll rename the items, period.

Also, this supports [font=Courier New]i18n[/font] translations. I welcome any translations to languages, and encourage using produce breeds local to the geography of the translation! Special shoutout to the following translators:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30715]Chinese translation[/url]﻿: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MOIRIS?gameId=1303]MOIRIS[/url]
[*]French translation: ﻿[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Caranud?pk_vid=a6c9736c8c4c32a9175337947505d720]Caranud[/url]﻿
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url],
[*]Download and unzip this mod into the [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[b][size=5]Configuration[/size]
[/b]There are currently no configuration options available for this mod.

[b][size=5]Compatibility
[/size][/b]This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.

The following mods are supported, renaming all items in these mods with new, non-duplicative names:
[list]
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22490]Bonster's Combined Crops and Recipes[/url]
[*]﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url] ﻿(see Cornucopia Mod Compatibility Options below)
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url] ﻿(see Cornucopia Mod Compatibility Options below)
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Goods[/url] ﻿(see Cornucopia Mod Compatibility Options below)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20884]Grains Overhull[/url]﻿
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22575]Ilucie's Winter Crops[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34390]Lilybrook[/url]﻿
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius﻿﻿[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿﻿
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28053?tab=description]Sekun's Crop Expansion[/url]﻿﻿
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded﻿[/url] 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]﻿
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url]
[*]For machine compatibility rules, I also support [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720]Machine Progression System﻿[/url]﻿
[/list]
[size=5]Cornucopia Mod Compatibility Options
[/size]For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url], ensure that the [font=Courier New]SVE Compat Patch[/font] configuration option is set to [font=Courier New]false[/font]. This will ensure all items remain in the game, as this mod acts as an alternative compatibility fix between the mods.
For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url], I recommend setting the SVE Compat option to [font=Courier New]true[/font]. I have no plans to add changes to the existing compatibility functionality for either of these mods. I personally play with both of those compatibility options enabled (Flowers renaming the conflicting crops just as this mod does, Artisan Goods effectively merging the conflicting items together) and that seems to strike an excellent balance between robustness to the content of the game and simplicity in the solution.

Downloads.Description: A handful of compatibility adds/fixes for many supported mods - should result in many more items being able to be used in more specific machine recipes - berries, grains, cornucopia extruder, sekun's and grains overhull, etc.

Manifest.Name: Vegas' Item Compatibility Patch
Manifest.Description: Renames items with conflicting names from all supported mods, and adds machine rule compatibility when necessary, allowing all items to be used together.
